title.narrative: Response to the main unattended health needs and that increase due to high human mobility and the impact of climate change.

description.narrative: The main objective of this project is to ensure continuity and availability of comprehensive health services that save lives and reduce avoidable morbidity and mortality, targeting particularly vulnerable groups affected by high human mobility and the impacts of climate change. This WHO project provides comprehensive health services to host communities, refugees, returnees, IDPs, and other affected individuals, through activities like provision of supplies and equipment, and improvement of health facilities. The project provides life-saving assistance to 70,000 individuals, comprising 18,872 men, 20,028 women, 15,168 boys, 15,932 girls, and 2,000 persons with disabilities.
